why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://www.minehood.io   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: Open minehood.io , the only site linked from @minehood_rh, and press Connect X. The site warns that "X's own sign in page lists wider read access because X offers no narrower choice for this kind of sign in. We use none of it."
Follow @minehood_rh, then like, reply to and repost the task post, confirming each one on the site.
Press Join the waitlist, then check @minehood_rh for new task posts, which add XP.
Wait for the game. The site says: "We will reach out on X when the doors open."
